title: 36Kr Exclusive: Quantum Computing Enterprise Founded by Protégé of "Father of Quantum Internet" Secures Over 100 Million Yuan Angel Round Financing Led by Legend Star
excerpt: This groundbreaking research pioneers a one-of-a-kind distributed quantum computing architecture, featuring a synergistic integration of a Neutral Atom Quantum Processing Unit (QPU) and an innovative Optical Quantum Interconnection QLink. This proprietary design addresses critical bottlenecks in scalable quantum computing by combining the exceptional qubit controllability of neutral-atom systems with high-fidelity, low-latency optical quantum interconnections, laying a robust technical foundation for large-scale, modular quantum computing deployment and advancing breakthroughs in next-generation distributed quantum information processing fields.

Author | Ou Xue

Editor | Yuan Silai

36Kr Hard Krypton learned that recently, neutral-atom quantum computing enterprise AtomCore Light (Shanghai) Quantum Technology Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as "AtomCore Light") announced the completion of an angel round financing of over 100 million yuan. This round of financing was jointly led by Lenovo Star and Shanghai Future Industry Fund, with joint investment from institutions including Beijing Zhongguancun Capital, Xuhui Capital, Jiaming Haochun, Silicon Harbor Capital, Jinyu Maowu, Tianyou Capital and other institutions. The funds will be mainly used for the technical iteration of neutral atom quantum processor (QPU) and optical quantum interconnection (QLink), the productization promotion of all-in-one quantum computing machines and the core team building.

Founded in Shanghai in April 2026, AtomCore Light is positioned as "the builder of quantum computing power clusters". The company has created an original distributed quantum computing architecture of "Neutral Atom QPU + Optical Quantum Interconnection QLink", which follows the "chiplet + interconnection" model of AI computing power clusters, providing a brand new technical path for breaking through the upper limit of the physical qubit scale of a single quantum computer.

The company's full Kimble-1 prototype was exhibited at the Pujiang Innovation Forum (Image source / The enterprise)

At present, most domestic quantum computing companies focus on improving the qubit scale of a single QPU, but Luan Xingsheng, founder of AtomCore Light, judges that the final form of quantum computing will be similar to AI computing power clusters, which connects multiple QPUs through optical interconnection to build a scalable large-scale distributed quantum computing system.

"Limited by underlying physical principles such as laser power and objective lens field of view, as well as material constraints, the upper limit of the scale of a single QPU is about 100,000 physical qubits, while running large-scale quantum algorithms with practical value may require millions or even tens of millions of physical qubits," Luan Xingsheng told Hard Krypton. He judges that the single-machine capacity expansion path will eventually reach the physical limit, and distributed quantum clusters are the feasible solution for large-scale quantum computing power.

The underlying logic of this idea comes from Luan Xingsheng's previous cross-cutting experience spanning quantum hardware, AI computing architecture and strategic consulting. He holds a doctorate in Applied Physics from the California Institute of Technology, studied under H. Jeff Kimble, a member of the U.S. National Academy of Sciences and the father of the quantum internet, and is the last doctoral student he supervised. During his doctoral studies, he mainly focused on the system integration of neutral atom arrays and photonic chips. After graduation, he successively served as a project manager at McKinsey, a core member of the Greater China high-tech business, and an AI technology strategy expert at ByteDance, responsible for the strategic planning of AI chips and computing architectures. These experiences allowed him to rethink the implementation path of large-scale quantum computing from multiple perspectives of quantum devices, computing architectures and industrial implementation.

"The previous idea of doing quantum computing was to make one QPU bigger and better, but sometimes you can't have the best of both worlds. Why can't we build large-scale computing power clusters in the 'chiplet + interconnection' way like AI computing now?" said Luan Xingsheng, "Quantum computing should also follow the same idea."

Thus, he put forward a clear technical route: neutral atom QPU undertakes quantum computing, and optical quantum interconnection QLink realizes interconnection between QPUs.

The advantages of the neutral atom platform lie in strong scalability, identical qubits and long coherence time, which is currently recognized by the industry as one of the most promising quantum computing routes for large-scale application. However, the neutral atom system also faces engineering challenges such as complex optical paths and huge vacuum systems, and the number of qubits that a single device can accommodate has an upper limit after all. Photons are natural "flying qubits", which can maintain quantum information at normal temperature and pressure, are suitable for long-distance transmission and interconnection of quantum information, and are compatible with the mature CMOS process of optical chips. But the interaction between photons is weak, so they are not suitable for direct computing.

"Let atoms do what they are good at — computing and storage; let photons do what they are good at — interconnection. That's the idea of our architecture," said Luan Xingsheng.

Centering on this architecture, AtomCore Light has built two core technical barriers: one is the preparation and high-fidelity manipulation of large-scale neutral atom arrays, and the other is QLink, a quantum interconnection interface based on photonic chips. QLink realizes the coherent mapping between atomic qubits and photons through the cavity QED interface, so as to connect multiple QPUs and complete quantum state transmission and entanglement distribution across nodes.

Detail view of Kimble-1 (Image source / The enterprise)

Next, AtomCore Light's technical roadmap is equally clear: the company plans to complete the distributed quantum computing demonstration between two QPU arrays by the end of 2027. If successfully implemented, it is expected to be the world's first on the neutral atom platform. By 2030, the goal is to realize the interconnection of 10 QPU nodes, land valuable quantum computing use cases, and complete the closed loop of quantum computing commercialization.

Luan Xingsheng said that the company hopes to achieve break-even between 2030 and 2031. "Before we carry out any business, we will ask: What is the ROI? When can we stop burning money? Quantum computing is a long-distance race, but even a long-distance race needs supply stations."

The following is an excerpt of the dialogue between Hard Krypton and Luan Xingsheng, founder of AtomCore Light (edited):

Hard Krypton: What is the commercialization route plan of AtomCore Light?

Luan Xingsheng: Our commercialization idea is divided into three layers. The first layer is the delivery of all-in-one quantum computing machines. According to my standard, a device can be called a product only if it can achieve "6-month maintenance-free operation". At present, the neutral atom quantum computing devices in the industry generally need to be maintained once a week or every two weeks, which is far from stable product delivery. We hope to launch an all-in-one quantum computing machine with 3000 physical qubits, a two-qubit gate fidelity exceeding the error correction threshold, and capable of 6-month maintenance-free operation by the end of 2027.

The second layer is "delivering value along the way". In the process of R&D of the all-in-one machine, we give full play to the technical accumulation of the California Institute of Technology laboratory in the ultra-high vacuum bonding technology of photonic chips, develop optical chip atomic devices packaged in ultra-high vacuum, and independently develop productizable sensor modules such as integrated quantum sensors and atomic clocks, so as to expand the application scope of atomic sensor devices for application scenarios such as large-scale industry, aerospace mapping and navigation. This can not only generate revenue in advance, but also continuously verify and iterate the technology through the usage feedback of real customers.

The third layer is post-quantum cryptography migration. Our team has senior background of nearly 10 years of strategic consulting for financial digital transformation at McKinsey. We believe that post-quantum cryptography migration is not a simple "algorithm replacement", but a systematic project that requires overall analysis and design, and phased iterative implementation, just like financial digital transformation. Therefore, we do not plan to only sell encryption devices, but hope to design and implement end-to-end post-quantum cryptography migration solutions in the form of digital transformation projects. This is the cash flow business of the company.

Hard Krypton: The headquarters is set in Shanghai, but the R&D base is set in Shanxi. How to coordinate the two?

Luan Xingsheng: On the one hand, our core technology is rooted in the cutting-edge research of the Quantum Optics Laboratory of the California Institute of Technology; on the other hand, we follow the business idea of "where the customers are, there the company should be" for layout. Our target customers, such as large AI manufacturers, financial institutions, pharmaceutical companies, etc., are mostly concentrated in Shanghai and its surrounding areas. Only in Shanghai can we develop around customer demands instead of working behind closed doors in the laboratory.

The State Key Laboratory of Quantum Optics and Quantum Optics Devices of Shanxi University has 40 years of accumulation in quantum optics, and is an important scientific research force in this field in China. I myself also serve as a researcher of this laboratory. At present, the Shanxi side undertakes basic research and technical exploration; in the future, Shanghai will continue to be the core window for industrial customers, focusing on engineering and productization to promote the commercialization of technologies.

Luan Xingsheng leading the team to do experiments (Image source / The enterprise)

Hard Krypton: The neutral atom track has been very hot in recent years. AtomCore Light is not the earliest to start, how do you catch up?

Luan Xingsheng: The first is technology. We inherit the technical route of the Quantum Optics Laboratory of the California Institute of Technology. As one of the world's earliest laboratories to carry out quantum state regulation of atoms and photons, this laboratory has 40 years of accumulation in quantum computing, communication and measurement. In the field of neutral atom arrays, since 2015, the laboratory has cooperated with the group of Cindy Regal, a pioneer in optical tweezer array experiments, realized a 1000-scale optical tweezer array in 2017, and completed the world's earliest experimental verification of the integration of optical tweezer atom arrays and photonic chips in 2020. My supervisor Professor Jeff Kimble has been deeply engaged in cavity QED since the 1980s, successively realized precise manipulation of single atoms, pioneered the integration direction of neutral atoms and photonic chips, and proposed the concept and implementation scheme of the quantum internet in 2008.

The second is architecture-level thinking and industrialization team. We are not only making a better QPU, but also designing "a scalable system" to build a large-scale quantum computing power cluster through quantum interconnection. The core members of the team come from top universities at home and abroad, covering multiple fields such as quantum computing, optoelectronic engineering, semiconductors, and industrial operation. There are many people in the quantum computing circle who understand physics, but very few people have personally gone through the mass production of hardware, which is our key differentiation.

Investor Views:

Lenovo Star said: Quantum computing is an important direction for the evolution of next-generation computing power, and it is also a cutting-edge technology field that Lenovo Star has long focused on. The breakthrough of the computing power industry not only relies on single-point technology, but also tests system engineering and productization capabilities. Centering on neutral atom quantum computing and on-chip cavity QED optical quantum interconnection, AtomCore Light has got through the system capabilities from core devices, QPU, quantum interconnection to the whole machine, and takes the all-in-one quantum computing machine as the core product form to continuously promote the transformation of technical achievements into landed products.

The team has both cutting-edge scientific research accumulation and industrialization practical experience, and has strong capabilities in hardware engineering and product definition, which is a rare "scientific research + engineering" compound team in early-stage hard technology projects. As an angel institution focusing on early-stage technology investment, Lenovo Star will rely on Legend Holdings' deep accumulation in the computing power industry, hardware supply chain and entrepreneurial ecosystem, continue to support enterprises to promote technology iteration and product landing, and accompany quantum computing from technical prototypes to large-scale industrial applications.

Shanghai Future Industry Fund said: Quantum computing is an important frontier of the new round of scientific and technological revolution and industrial transformation, and it is also a key layout direction for Shanghai's future industries. The fund continues to pay attention to the field of quantum technology, focusing on laying out cutting-edge technical routes with original innovation capabilities and long-term industrial value. Neutral atom quantum computing has unique advantages in the construction of large-scale qubit arrays, coherence time and system scalability. Centering on "Neutral Atom QPU + Optical Quantum Interconnection QLink", AtomCore Light builds a differentiated technical system, explores the distributed quantum computing architecture, has built a neutral atom quantum computing prototype verification platform, and continues to promote the R&D of key technologies such as optical quantum interconnection, showing good potential for technological innovation. In the future, the fund will give full play to the advantages of long-term capital and industrial ecological resources, continuously empower in aspects such as talent cultivation, scientific research resource docking, industrial collaboration and capital resource link, support enterprises to carry out key technology research and industrialization exploration, accelerate the transformation of quantum technology innovation achievements, and inject new momentum into Shanghai's quantum technology innovation and future industrial development.

Beijing Zhongguancun Capital said: Quantum computing belongs to the long-cycle, high-barrier hard technology track. The investment focuses on the long-term feasibility of the technical route and the potential of the team to transform scientific research achievements into engineering capabilities and product capabilities. AtomCore Light is deeply engaged in neutral atom quantum computing, builds a differentiated technical system relying on on-chip cavity QED optical quantum interconnection, and takes the all-in-one quantum computing machine as the core product form to continuously promote the evolution of technical prototypes to engineered products.

The team has both cutting-edge scientific research capabilities and strong engineering and industrialization capabilities, forming a complete capability chain from scientific research tackling, system integration to product landing. Zhongguancun Capital adheres to the investment philosophy of investing in early-stage, small-sized and hard technology enterprises, and accompanies the growth of enterprises with continuous patient capital. In the future, it will rely on its own industrial ecology to continuously provide support in team building, industrial chain collaboration and subsequent financing, and help accelerate the industrialization process of neutral atom quantum computing.
